summary: Core SAT math question generation capability: accepts an InceptBench-compatible JSON request, runs the LLM generation pipeline via asyncio.gather (parallel Gemini and Claude calls through litellm), persists produced assets to Google Cloud Storage, traces execution via Langfuse, and returns the generated question JSON. Also exposes a GET introspection endpoint listing supported POST parameters.

evidence.claim: POST /generate triggers the generation pipeline with asyncio.gather and writes results to GCS
GET /generate returns a GenerateInfoResponse contract summary describing supported POST parameters
POST /generate depends on verify_auth FastAPI dependency for optional Bearer/X-API-Key token auth
Generation pipeline integrates Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude via litellm, Langfuse tracing, GCS asset write, and InceptBench API

invariants.statement: Auth is optional: when SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN env var is unset the endpoint is open (local dev mode)
Generation uses asyncio.gather for parallel LLM calls, not sequential execution
Generated assets are stored in GCS before the response is returned

scenarios.name: happy-path generation
scenarios.given: A valid InceptBench-compatible JSON body and an optional Bearer token
scenarios.then: The pipeline runs, assets are written to GCS, and a GenerateResponse JSON is returned

scenarios.name: contract introspection
scenarios.given: A client that wants to know what parameters POST /generate accepts
scenarios.then: A GenerateInfoResponse JSON is returned describing supported parameters

scenarios.name: unauthenticated local dev
scenarios.when: POST /generate is called without any auth header
scenarios.then: The request is accepted and processed normally

rebuild_decisions.name: LLM provider routing
options: Route all calls through litellm for provider abstraction
Call Gemini and Claude SDKs directly without an abstraction layer
rebuild_decisions.constraints_from_source: litellm is used as the provider abstraction layer

rebuild_decisions.name: Pipeline parallelism
options: Use asyncio.gather for parallel LLM sub-calls within a single request
rebuild_decisions.constraints_from_source: asyncio.gather is used in the generation pipeline
